signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to reach your purchases and download your files.
signIn.verifiedNotice: Your email is confirmed. You can sign in now.
signIn.resetNotice: Your password was changed. Sign in with your new password.
signIn.magicLinkTitle: Sign in with an email link
signIn.magicLinkDescription: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to sign in without a password.
signIn.magicLinkSent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent it a sign-in link. The link expires in 10 minutes.
signIn.magicLinkFailed: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.description: Create an account to buy products and download them from My Purchases.
signUp.captchaLabel: Verify that you are not a robot
signUp.checkInboxBody: We've sent a confirmation link to <email></email>. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for that email, we've sent it a password reset link. The link expires in one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: You will be signed out on all other devices once the password is changed.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

verifyEmail.successBody: Your account is active. Sign in to continue.
verifyEmail.errorBody: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Sign in and we'll send you a new one.
verifyEmail.pendingBody: Open the confirmation link we sent you to activate your account.

errors.invalidCredentials: The details you entered are incorrect.
errors.emailNotVerified: Your email isn't confirmed yet. We've sent you a new confirmation link.
errors.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordCompromised: This password has appeared in previous data breaches. Choose a different one.
errors.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.signInFailed: We couldn't sign you in. Contact support if this keeps happening.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
